text:
maya: Tiny office orchestra at 3pm in the kitchen? Bring a utensil or a kazoo. Very serious vibes. :tada:
+ oliver: I will bring my lucky coffee stirrer. It's seen three sprints and a pivot.
+ devin: kazoo AND spoons. Also vote: percussion only or full band?
+ sara: percussion only. My air tambourine skills are unmatched. :drum:
+ jen: can we make it a 2-minute performance so it counts as a meeting? Asking for my calendar. :sweat_smile:
+ alex: add it as "cross-team morale sync" and we're golden.
+ maya: poll: 1) Percussion 2) Full band 3) Solo kazoo — react with :one: :two: or :three:
+ ops-bot: Heads-up: kitchen fridge cleanout at 4pm, please label instruments you want rescued.
+ oliver: also will there be a ceremonial coffee sip? gotta mark the moment.
+ devin: quick one-liner challenge while we tune: "If my plant could play, it'd be on lead guitar." go.
+ sara: "My stapler is tone-deaf but committed."
+ jen: "Desk lamp insists on jazz."
+ alex: "I taught my mouse to tap-sync."
+ maya: Love these. Meet at 3.05 (late entrances add dramatic flair). :mic_drop:
